info.name: Sign In Solutions VMS AuditLogs API

params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the results to a specified number, defaults to 50

params.name: offset
params.description: Offsets the results to a specified number, defaults to 0

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sorts by the field name and direction provided where the pattern is `FIELD_NAME_DIRECTION`

params.name: auditable_id
params.description: The unique ID of a model that has associated audit logs

params.name: auditable_type
params.description:
The name of the model that has associated audit logs. Valid values include:
- `user`
- `device_configuration`
- `signin`
- `invite`
- `watchlist_record`
- `account_preference`
- `signout`
- `host`
- `invite_watchlist`
- `location_preference`
- `parking_lot`
- `parking_stall`
- `permission_bundle`
- `person`
- `physical_access_grant`
- `physical_access_provider`
- `physical_access_rule`
- `security_badge_type`
- `signin_watchlist`
- `user_group_physical_access_rule`
- `visitor`
- `bulk_data_batch`

params.name: action_type
params.description:
The action performed by the user. Valid values include:
- `create`
- `update`
- `destroy`

params.name: user_id
params.description: The ID of the user who performed the database change
